name: Premier Energies Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest solar-cell maker (10.6 GW cells, 11.1 GW modules) integrating forward into modules, EPC/transformers and backward/sideways into ingot-wafer (10 GW), aluminium frames and BESS (6 GWh, July 2027; 12 GWh JV with RCT Nexor). Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 2,632-2,656 cr (+38-43%), operating EBITDA ~Rs 736-760 cr (28%), PAT Rs 462 cr (+31%); order book 10.7 GW / Rs 16,600 cr, 99% domestic. Net debt Rs 1,911 cr and heavy capex. Promoter holding fell to 58.5% (from 63.9%) in Jun 2026. Pack's Screener quarterly table (sales Rs 253 cr) is not consolidated and is ignored.

cost_structure.input: Glass, EVA, backsheet, frames, junction boxes

exposures.mechanism: ALMM List-II (modules from domestic cells) took effect in June 2026 and drove a record 34 GW dc H1 installation rush, then a supply crunch (Wood Mackenzie: system prices +20% by Q4 2026). Premier is India's largest cell maker (10.6 GW cells, 7 GW TOPCon cells commissioning). +1 = stronger support (e.g. extended ALMM/DCR, PM Surya Ghar, storage VGF) -> demand/price +8% on ~99% domestic book; revenue +8% with 40% price-flow-through -> EBITDA +12%; EV/MCap 1.1; persistence 0.5 -> +6.6, trimmed -> +6.

evidence.note: ALMM-II effective June 2026; cell supply constraints; utility-scale prices +20% by Q4 2026
99% of Rs 16,600 cr order book is domestic

exposures.mechanism: Structural RE/storage build-out (India >50 GW dc solar in 2026; BESS 6 GWh plant July 2027, 12 GWh JV with RCT Nexor). +1 = transition capex 10% above plan -> cell/module/BESS volumes +6% -> EBITDA +7% (leverage 1.2x); EV/MCap 1.1; persistence 0.6 -> +4.6, partly overlaps P_RENEWABLE_SUPPORT so trimmed -> +4.

evidence.note: BESS first phase July 2027, ingot-wafer 10 GW, aluminium frames Sept 2027

exposures.mechanism: Premier is cell-integrated, so module/cell realisations drop through more than for module-only makers. +10% realisation with ~40% passing to margin = +4% of revenue; EBITDA margin 28% -> EBITDA +14%; EV/MCap 1.1; persistence 0.25 (supply catches up as 60-70 GW of Indian cell capacity arrives, per JM) -> +3.9. Q2 operating margin already slid to 28% from 30.5% (higher material costs).

evidence.note: Operating EBITDA margin 28% vs 30.5% y/y and 29% in Q1 on higher material costs
Cell supply constraints push prices up near term

exposures.mechanism: Silver paste for TOPCon metallisation is ~8-10% of cell cost (estimate), i.e. ~4-5% of module COGS; +12% silver -> +0.5% COGS ~0.4% of revenue at partial pass-through -> EBITDA -1.5%; with EV/MCap 1.1 and persistence 0.5 -> ~-0.9; empirical -1.79 (t -1.9) agrees in sign and is larger, so blended to -1.4. Silver is -30% since 1 Jun 2026 (a tailwind already in margins).

99% domestic INR revenue but imported wafers/polysilicon, glass, EVA/backsheet, silver and Chinese capex machinery priced in USD (est. ~45% of COGS). +3% USD/INR -> COGS +1.4%; 50% passed to price -> 0.7% x 72% COGS/revenue = 0.5% of revenue -> EBITDA -1.8%; EV/MCap 1.1; persistence 0.5 -> -1.0. Capex (Rs ~8,000 cr programme, USD-priced equipment) adds to the cost.

evidence.note: Heavy capex: 7 GW cell plant, ingot-wafer 10 GW, 6 GWh BESS

exposures.mechanism: Net debt Rs 1,911 cr (Sep 2026) and D/E 0.72 with H1 investing outflow Rs 1,567 cr vs operating cash flow Rs 669 cr, so borrowing rises. +25 bp -> interest on ~Rs 6,000 cr average debt +Rs 15 cr = EBITDA/PAT -1% plus a discount-rate effect on a ~21x annualised-PAT stock (derived) and developers' financing cost -> -1.5.

evidence.note: Net debt Rs 1,911 cr vs 1,642 cr in Q1; operating cash flow H1 Rs 669 cr, investing outflow Rs 1,567 cr

exposures.mechanism: Aluminium frames are ~8% of module cost (estimate); in-house frame plant due Sept 2027. +10% aluminium -> +0.8% module COGS, ~50% passed -> 0.3% of revenue -> EBITDA -1% x 1.1 x 0.5 = -0.5.

Duties on Chinese cells/glass/modules protect Indian pricing. +1 = new broad duties -> domestic price umbrella +5% on the ~45% of revenue exposed to import parity; EBITDA +10%; x1.1 x persistence 0.5 -> +5.5, trimmed for uncertainty about which products. Exact current India ADD status on cells not verified in this run (model knowledge, low).

evidence.note: DGTR proceedings on Chinese solar cells/modules/glass; status not re-verified

exposures.mechanism: US final AD 123.04% + CVD 126.09% on Indian cells/modules (Commerce, 11 Sep 2026) and Section 232 MIPs from 4 Dec 2026 close the US to Indian cell exports; Premier's export share is only ~1% of order book, so direct hit is small. Residual: Indian capacity redirected to the home market lowers domestic prices (second-order, shown in price-node edge).

evidence.note: US final AD 123.04%, CVD 126.09% for Indian producers

supply_chain.note: Rs 16,600 cr order book; Rs 4,001 cr orders added in Q2 (2,308 MW)
Module leader; Premier is more cell-integrated
Imported inputs until ingot-wafer plant (Dec 2027 / Dec 2028)

company_events.event: 7 GW TOPCon cell plant commercial production start (company: 'shortly')
Further cell/module price compression as Indian cell capacity scales (JM: 60-70 GW)

current_state.latest_quarter: Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026), reported 2026-11-04: revenue +43% y/y (Rs 2,632 cr), op EBITDA 28% (vs 30.5%), PAT Rs 462 cr +31%; cell production 916 MW (+54%), module 1,199 MW; interim dividend Rs 0.50
current_state.trend: Volume and utilisation strong (cells 99%, modules 92%); margins sliding on material costs; cash conversion weak (CFO/PAT 0.72).
current_state.valuation: Market cap ~Rs 39,700 cr at Rs 874-904; ~21x annualised H1 FY27 PAT (derived, Q1 PAT ~Rs 471 cr + Q2 462 cr). 52w Rs 660-1,134; 3m -16%, 12m -16%.
recent_developments: 2026-09-14/15: US finalises AD/CVD on Indian solar; PREMIERENE/WAAREEENER in focus
2026-09-21: Rs 3,293 cr Andhra cell facility commissioned
2026-11-04: Q2 results and order book Rs 16,600 cr

key_risks: Cell oversupply as Indian cell capacity scales faster than demand after the ALMM-II rush
Leverage and execution on ingot-wafer, BESS and 7 GW cell plant
upside_triggers: Extension/tightening of ALMM or DCR rules
BESS and wafer integration lowering cost
